## About
Robinson's Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop on Hughes Road in Dickinson, TX. Our technicians and mechanics handle services big and small, and our goal is simple: do the repair the right way, the first time.
When something doesn't feel or sound right with your car, give us a call or send a service request. One longtime customer wrote that Joe and Julie run the shop, and another brings the whole family's Toyotas and Honda here for whatever they need.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 107 reviews. We're open weekdays and look forward to seeing you.

## Services
- Lube, oil and filter change: Routine oil and filter service to keep your engine running well.
- Engine diagnostics and performance: When something doesn't feel or sound right, we'll look into what's going on.
- Steering and suspension: Service for your car's steering and suspension system.
- Axle, CV joint and driveshaft repair
- Electrical and electronic systems
- Tire pressure monitoring system

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule a service?
A: Give us a call or send a service request online. A request doesn't lock in a time, but we'll get back to you within 24 hours to set one up.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: When you request service, you can let us know whether you plan to wait for your vehicle or leave it with us.
